preconditions.description: The length of the sequences n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The boundaries l and r satisfy 1 <= l <= r <= 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(l <= x <= r for x in a)
preconditions.description: The sequence a has length n and all its elements are within [l, r].

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and len(set(p)) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in p)
preconditions.description: The sequence p has length n, contains distinct integers, and all elements are between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output == '-1' or (len(b) == n and all(l <= x <= r for x in b) and all(c[i] != c[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n)) and all(rank(c[i], c) == p[i] for i in range(n)))
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output is '-1'. Otherwise, output is a sequence b of length n where each element is in [l, r], the derived sequence c (where c[i] = b[i] - a[i]) has all distinct elements, and the rank of each c[i] in c (count of elements <= c[i]) equals p[i].

postconditions.expression: output != '-1' implies any(rank(x, c) == p[i] for i, x in enumerate(c))
postconditions.description: If a solution is provided, the compressed sequence of the derived c must exactly match the input p.
